description: Portrait of a smiling man, leaning on the ground holding a coffee cup, wearing a denim shirt with snaps and a cowboy hat, visible in the background is another man sitting on a stool with a coffee cup in his hand.  This photograph is part of an album created by Ansel Adams after his 1938 trip to Yosemite with Georgia O'Keeffe, David McAlpin, and Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller. This is one of only three albums created for his travel companions documenting their trip.
title: Untitled (Robert Barnett?)
